Cc: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Briefing request - Redwood demo (CIO attendance?)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the intro — we’re excited to get a demo scheduled. Our CIO (David Hsu) is the primary decision-maker for inference platforms; he’s asked to attend the exec portion if possible. Right now his calendar is tight next week, but we can hold a 90-minute slot that includes a 20-minute exec intro + 60-minute deep dive + 10-minute Q&A. Two constraints:

- We need a short pre-brief (15-30 mins) with the CIO or his EA to run through the strategic points (risks, compliance, migration impact).
- Nimbus needs SOC 2 evidence and a short mutual action plan before exec time.

Can you propose 2-3 windows next week? Preferred time is US/Pacific mornings. If the CIO cannot make the full slot, we need a clear delegate/backup plan so the meeting still lands.

Appreciate it —
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Strategy, NimbusCloud
[samir.patel@nimbuscloud.com]

I’ve looped in Marissa to lock capacity and create a mutual action plan and SOC2 packet. I’ll hold Tue morning tentatively until we confirm.

Best,
